title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly Brief
subheading: Cross-sector overview: momentum, news, themes & the week ahead
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This brief synthesizes the eight sector dashboards for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

sector_scoreboard.story: Alphabet beat Q2 estimates but fell >7% — worst day in a year — after raising capex guidance to $195–205B; Mag 7 lost 5.7% in a week as spending is now punished, not rewarded
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: TSMC (+34% rev) and NVIDIA (record $75.2B Data Center rev) validate real demand; the ~10:1 capex-to-revenue ratio remains the bear case

sector_scoreboard.story: ISRG sinks 25%+ YTD despite an earnings beat; Chinese humanoid IPO rush accelerates (Unitree STAR approval now ~$14.7B, LimX closes $200M pre-IPO at $2.2B)
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Warehouse automation (SYM $22.7B backlog) is where the revenue is; Unitree's profit fell 52% YoY even as its IPO cleared — multiples, not fundamentals, doing the work

sector_scoreboard.story: Anduril in talks to raise at ~$100B — over 3x last year's mark, up from $61B just two months ago; Helsing closed $1.8B at $18B with demand exceeding allocation
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Record backlogs (L3Harris $40.7B) but AVAV/KTOS still down 40%+ YTD — the private/public valuation gap keeps widening

sector_scoreboard.story: Oklo received DOE startup authorization for its Groves reactor Jul 23 — yet the stock slid to the low $40s anyway as Barclays, Goldman and Truist all cut price targets
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Zero operating SMR plants; Aug 13 NRC mandatory hearing on Clinch River's construction permit is the next real de-risking event, not sentiment

sector_scoreboard.story: MP Materials lands $900M in new capital (Apple offtake + DoD stake); Lynas posts record revenue (+70% YoY) but shares fall anyway
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: $2.9B+ federal funding blitz is a real demand floor; China's Nov 10 export-control reprieve expiry remains the sector's biggest swing factor

sector_scoreboard.story: SpaceX now down ~47% from its post-IPO high after a Starship test abort; Rocket Lab draws fresh buyers on an Air Force win plus Iridium follow-through
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Starlink ARPU keeps sliding ($86→$66) even as subscribers hit 10.3M (+105%); H1 2026 was still a record $67.7B investment year for the sector

sector_scoreboard.story: GE Vernova posts a blowout Q2 — orders +88% YoY, backlog hits $176B, on track for $200B by 2027; Tesla deploys record-adjacent 13.5 GWh but energy margin nearly halves
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Best revenue visibility on this list — 24.3 GW US buildout on track for a record year; China's cost advantage (CATL/BYD) plus new 58%+ effective tariffs remain the structural fight

sector_scoreboard.story: Relay Therapeutics whipsawed between fresh Buy initiations and a Zacks downgrade to Strong Sell within the same two weeks; Recursion fell ~8% on an unfavorable trial readout
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: 173 AI-discovered programs are now in clinical development — zero have reached full FDA approval; H1 VC funding still hit $9.1B, strongest since 2022

sector_scoreboard.story: D-Wave transfers its listing to Nasdaq Jul 27; PsiQuantum expands its DARPA deal to $125M even as a $988M five-year insider-selling tally circulates across IonQ/RGTI/QBTS
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: P/S 109–836× prices in decades of perfect execution; insiders have sold ~$988M against under $4M in purchases — conviction gap, not just valuation gap

cross_cutting_themes.title: The market flips on AI spending
cross_cutting_themes.description: Alphabet beat Q2 estimates but fell >7% — its worst day in over a year — after raising 2026 capex guidance to $195–205B; the Magnificent Seven lost 5.7% in a single week. This week's Microsoft/Meta (Jul 29) and Amazon (Jul 30) reports test whether that punishment dynamic holds across the rest of Big Tech.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Intelligence gets a body — and a price tag
cross_cutting_themes.description: Robotics, defense autonomy, and space systems share the same stack: NVIDIA compute, foundation models (Skild, Physical Intelligence), actuators and sensors. Anduril in talks at ~$100B — over 3x last year's mark — is the clearest proof yet that private markets are pricing autonomy as a generational bet, even as public pure-plays (AVAV, KTOS) stay repriced 40%+ below highs.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Onshoring as investment thesis
cross_cutting_themes.description: Rare earths, defense production, quantum policy, CHIPS funding — governments are now price-setters and demand floors across half these sectors. MP Materials' $900M in new capital (Apple + DoD) and a $2.9B+ federal minerals blitz show the playbook is scaling, even as China's entity-list retaliation shows the policy risk cuts both ways.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The valuation divergence
cross_cutting_themes.description: Quantum, humanoids, and SMRs trade on narratives; storage, warehouse automation, and defense backlogs trade on booked revenue. Oklo cleared a real regulatory milestone (DOE startup authorization) and still sold off on profit-taking — proof the market is now demanding execution, not just catalysts, before it pays up.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Private giants going public — and repricing fast
cross_cutting_themes.description: SpaceX is now down ~47% from its post-IPO high; Anthropic and OpenAI both sit on confidential S-1s, with OpenAI reportedly leaning toward a 2027 debut as Altman holds out for $1T; D-Wave just uplisted to Nasdaq. Whether debuts hold remains the best real-time sentiment gauge for the whole complex.

news_of_the_week.title: Alphabet Q2 beat, stock falls >7% anyway
news_of_the_week.description: Worst day in over a year after capex guidance rose to $195–205B and free cash flow went negative for the first time since the 2004 IPO.

news_of_the_week.title: Anduril in talks at ~$100B valuation
news_of_the_week.description: Over 3x last year's mark and up from $61B just two months ago — would near Lockheed Martin's ~$130B market cap; no deal finalized.

news_of_the_week.title: Oklo clears DOE authorization, stock slides anyway
news_of_the_week.description: Groves reactor cleared for fuel loading and first criticality — a genuine regulatory milestone — yet OKLO fell to the low $40s as analysts cut targets.

news_of_the_week.title: GE Vernova posts a blowout Q2
news_of_the_week.description: Orders +88% YoY to $24.2B; total backlog hits $176B, on track for $200B by 2027 — the sector's clearest fundamentals story this week.

news_of_the_week.title: D-Wave uplists to Nasdaq amid an insider-selling flag
news_of_the_week.description: Listing transfer coincides with a $988M five-year insider-selling tally across IonQ/Rigetti/D-Wave against under $4M in insider buying.

week_ahead.title: FOMC meeting & rate decision
week_ahead.description: Widely expected to hold; Q2 GDP (est. +2.3% annualized), June PCE and durable goods land the same week — near-term rate-path catalysts for every long-duration sector on this hub.

week_ahead.title: Microsoft, Meta & Amazon report Q2
week_ahead.description: The real test of whether last week's AI-capex punishment (Alphabet -7%) extends across the rest of Big Tech; 175 S&P 500 companies report this week overall.

week_ahead.title: BAE Systems half-year results
week_ahead.description: First earnings test after a European defense-sector selloff (BAE, Hensoldt, Renk, Saab, Leonardo all down on the month).

week_ahead.title: Palantir Q2 earnings
week_ahead.description: FY26 revenue guide already raised to $7.65–7.66B (+71% YoY); valuation vs growth durability remains the debate.

week_ahead.title: NRC mandatory hearing on Clinch River SMR permit
week_ahead.description: Final procedural step before a first-of-its-kind construction permit can be issued — the sector's next real de-risking event.

footnote: ABOUT THIS BRIEF Synthesized weekly from the nine sector dashboards (each independently researched Monday mornings) plus cross-sector market review. Sources are cited on each sector page. Figures approximate as of Jul 27, 2026 — always confirm independently.
